dossier.title: Silent Run
briefing: I'm {PATRON} here at {HERE}. I need three tonnes of narcotics moved to a neighbouring world, past the patrols. This is quiet work, entirely off the books.
You land at the target unscanned, drop the cargo, and leave. No police inspections, no records, nothing traced. The authorities are vigilant, so you'll need to plan your approach.
Payment waits at the destination. It's straightforward work if you're discreet. Are you interested?
